description: Mobilité - Vélos loués par le service CAP sur le vélo - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Number and types of bicycles rented by the CAP service on the VELO since 1999. This is the annual statement of the number of bicycles in circulation. Since January 2016, the data has come from the rental management system used by the community. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Mobility - Bicycles rented by the CAP service on the bike - Grand Poitiers" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include CAP sur le vélo, VAE, vélos. The listing shows 2021-03-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
